g.text: Figure 8 Feature Diagram — Audit Support System
(● mandatory, ○ optional; F-AUTO lists the four supported levels, the effective level is a run-time attribute per procedure instance)
supported autonomy levels (all four are always present)
the effective level of a procedure instance is a run-time attribute, not a product choice (7.4)
gated procedure (F-GATE) => effective level = L1, never L4
blind flag: set on L1 when cumulative downgrade hits the floor;
Solid line = sub-feature of the node it hangs from; unlabelled junctions are drawing aids, not features
Dashed boxes = the four supported levels (always all present) and the run-time constraints that pick the effective level per procedure instance (7.1, 7.4)
«requires» = cross-tree constraint (12.6): F-BLIND requires F-QUEUE; F-FEEDBACK requires F-OVERRIDE
«excludes» notation is not used: this product has no mutually exclusive features; "gated procedure never runs at L4" is a run-time object constraint, shown in the dashed note
M-xx / O-xx = requirement traced in the matrix (12.4)
